note: B6 IDs identify audit register records, not global research Claim IDs. Pending PR evidence is not part of the main baseline.

records.topic: LLVM backend vs canonical semantics
records.finding: LLVM is a replaceable backend; SPG remains the semantic authority. LLVM verifier/codegen success is not source-level preservation proof.
records.required_action: Keep lowering, optimizer, target and runtime preservation as separate evidence gates.
records.decision_owner: Future backend/language design; no decision required by audit

records.topic: Scenario 32/33 parser bridge vs Scenario 34 open source-to-query proof
records.finding: The parser bridge can decode v2 JSON and compare CPC assumptions with a Lean-constructed term without proving that the payload is the formula derived from source semantics.
records.required_action: Preserve separate claims for decoder/parser-state binding and source-derived formula correspondence.

records.topic: Scenario 20-24 experimental dependency discovery vs Scenario 25 formal semantic direction
records.finding: These are complementary layers: experimental observation/classification/scheduling and formal semantic dependency reasoning. Neither invalidates the other.
records.required_action: Retain typed scope and evidence basis for each dependency source.

records.topic: RT-05 resource vocabulary vs RT-26 runtime enforcement
records.finding: SPG may represent resource concepts but explicitly excludes runtime resource accounting/enforcement validation. RT-26 is a separate research gate.
records.required_action: Do not treat SPG representation as RT-26 evidence.

records.topic: ImpHash vs ImplHash
records.finding: Both spellings occur in active research terminology; no authoritative naming decision is recorded in the reviewed baseline.
records.required_action: Choose one canonical term and define migration/alias policy before normative schema use; do not silently normalize.

records.topic: Semantic value, managed occurrence, stable ID and lineage
records.finding: The documents distinguish immutable value identity, scoped occurrence/slot and continuity/lineage but do not specify their normative mapping and lifecycle.
records.required_action: Define create/copy/move/delete-recreate/split-merge/import/recursive-group semantics and canonical hash envelope.

records.topic: Contract refinement to operation/implementation conformance bridge
records.finding: Call-site required/provided contract refinement is not equivalent to CCHash membership; mapping to exact OpHash, ImplHash and conformance evidence is absent.
records.required_action: Specify typed mapping and fail-closed UNKNOWN behavior.

records.topic: Action Key and complete dependency closure
records.finding: Per-action dependency closure, resolved binding inputs, evidence freshness and trust are not complete. Caller semantic hash alone is insufficient for execution-sensitive reuse.
records.required_action: Define per-action key schemas and test binding-only changes for compile/link/execute/test/proof.

records.topic: Source semantics to LLVM/backend/runtime preservation
records.finding: Finite LLVM 19.1.7 x86-64 probes do not prove general lowering preservation, other targets, allocator provenance or end-to-end runtime behavior.
records.required_action: Build revision-pinned source-to-IR-to-target evidence chain and differential/formal checks for declared subsets.

records.topic: Package identity, provider closure and publisher trust
records.finding: Content digest does not prove publisher authority, provenance authenticity, archive/index identity or complete transitive provider closure.
records.required_action: Specify independent identity, provenance, signature/trust and closure gates.

records.topic: RT-26 resource accounting and enforcement
records.finding: Main baseline records RT-26 as Not started; mandatory resource dimensions, attribution, limits, overshoot, handlers and platform enforcement lack a merged end-to-end evidence chain.
records.required_action: Separate resource dimensions and platform guarantees; incorporate only merged PR evidence after review.

records.topic: Composition of resource-budget authority and authorization
records.finding: The composition of parent budget delegation, task capabilities, tool/agent authorization and OS/container enforcement authority is unspecified.
records.required_action: Define authority boundaries and adversarial cases; preserve platform-specific enforcement classes.

records.topic: Scenario 34 trust boundary and source-derived CPC assumptions
records.finding: SC-1–SC-7 are kernel-checked for a restricted deterministic Int/Bool fragment, but Python v2 JSON/CPC assumptions are not proved to be exactly the source-derived formula. SCW-30–41 include remaining closure, adversarial, axiom-audit, CI and acceptance gates.
records.required_action: Close each SCW obligation with a separate claim/evidence record; do not call the full source-to-Logos chain proven.

records.topic: Python prototype test discovery vs Required CI execution
records.finding: The audited family contains 32 test modules/376 test_* methods while Required CI selected 12 modules/177 methods; source inventory and CI selection are not interchangeable.
records.required_action: Track discovered, selected, executed, passed and claim-supporting tests as separate relations.

records.topic: Per-experiment reproduction provenance
records.finding: Reproduction is bounded and present for selected native/LLVM slices, but experiment metadata is not uniform; Scenario 130 historical record omits exact SQLite source ID, leaving version-level equivalence only.
records.required_action: Bind each execution to source revision, exact tool/build, command, environment, input/output hashes and claim scope.

records.topic: External snapshot completeness and provenance closure
records.finding: Some snapshots are partial or lack relative-link/proto import closure; URL presence and local copy do not establish complete source closure.
records.required_action: Record snapshot completeness, source revision, missing imports/links and retrieval provenance per source.

records.topic: Current full-corpus Markdown links and anchors
records.finding: Historical link scan does not establish current full-corpus link/anchor integrity after subsequent document additions and edits.
records.required_action: Run a current recursive-tree link and anchor audit, classifying partial verbatim snapshots separately.

records.topic: No corpus-wide stable Claim ID namespace
records.finding: Claims are identified locally by section/scenario labels; no stable cross-artifact claim identity model exists.
records.required_action: Inventory local claim labels and design migration-compatible IDs before publishing a complete machine graph.

records.topic: Test declaration, discovery, execution and support are conflated
records.finding: A test source, CI selection, successful job and claim-supporting result are distinct states and are not consistently normalized.
records.required_action: Adopt distinct edge/status types; require exact execution and result evidence before supports_claim.

records.topic: PLAN scheduling metadata vs exit-criteria acceptance
records.finding: Inventory plan_stages and links to PLAN are candidate scheduling relations, not proof of exit criteria. PLAN §0.1 retains claim validation, reproducibility, current links and external completeness work.
records.required_action: Represent scheduled_in separately from satisfies_exit_criterion and bind each checked item to evidence.

records.topic: Semantic duplicate review is not all-pairs corpus exhaustive
records.finding: Exact blob scan covers the pinned 488-file tree, but semantic overlap review covers identified high-risk candidate families rather than every paragraph/section pair.
records.required_action: Keep residual pairs unresolved; prioritize by shared claim/RT/prototype/evidence references.

records.topic: Scenario 16 missing
records.finding: No Scenario 16 report is present; corpus evidence does not determine whether the number was reserved or an artifact is missing.
records.required_action: Retain the gap; do not renumber or fabricate a report.

records.topic: Git semantic repository proposal
records.finding: The earlier broad current-architecture proposal and embedded ADR-0001 are superseded only for the external-KV-authoritative/current direction; surrounding alternatives and historical analysis remain valid background.
records.required_action: Link current readers to successor docs; preserve original report and historical claims.

records.topic: Related-project scan vs deep comparison
records.finding: Deep comparison supersedes the initial scan only for four deeply reviewed projects and inspected claims; the broad scan remains broader.
records.required_action: Preserve broad scan and scope successor links.

records.topic: Scenario 134 internal wire compatibility matrix
records.finding: Cross-version internal component compatibility matrix is inactive under the recorded same-build/same-toolchain decision; prior-art findings and external/persistent boundaries remain relevant.
records.required_action: Do not treat Scenario 134 as a current implementation requirement absent a documented reconsideration trigger.

records.topic: Scenario 31 initial query representation
records.finding: Scenario 32/33/34 supersede the initial text-oriented serialization/bridge sketches in scope, but Scenario 31's strict QF_LIA profile remains relevant.
records.required_action: Keep section-level scope; do not mark whole Scenario 31 superseded.

records.topic: Scenario 30 no-Lean-wrapper status
records.finding: Scenario 30's original no-wrapper status is historical after Scenario 33; the source-derived proof-binding goal remains open.
records.required_action: Label historical status and link Scenario 33 without closing proof obligations.

records.topic: Scenario 95 study and execution report
records.finding: The execution report is a companion/follow-up, not a replacement or duplicate of the broader study.
records.required_action: Maintain both nodes and explicit companion edge.

records.topic: Scenario 96 / 96A / 96B
records.finding: 96A integer and 96B byte-view experiments add distinct evidence layers; neither replaces the broader Scenario 96 study.
records.required_action: Keep distinct claims and evidence edges.

records.topic: Lean version and CI status in Scenario 33/34 and family README
records.finding: The audited implementation/workflow pins Lean 4.36.0 while some current-status text still says 4.34.0 or cites older CI as latest; exact audited-head CI evidence is recorded by B-02b.1.
records.required_action: Update current-state headers/links while preserving historical toolchain/run history.

records.topic: Scenario 30/31/32 status headers
records.finding: Top-level statuses such as no wrapper, no code changes, or CI running lag later implementation/CI evidence. Scenario 31 also contains a status statement inconsistent with its own implementation section.
records.required_action: Add dated status addenda or correct current header while preserving historical chronology.

records.topic: Scenario 102 test count 7 vs current file 8 methods
records.finding: Report states seven focused result-policy tests passed while current test source contains eight test methods; revision/test-selection relationship is not reconciled.
records.required_action: Inspect exact historical test revision and CI selection; state whether one test was added later or omitted from run.

records.topic: PLAN §0.1 contains superseded inventory/count snapshots
records.finding: PLAN retains older counts (24 RT/94 DEP, 243/245 prototypes and 474/471 artifacts in historical narrative) while current baseline inventory has 26 RT/108 DEP, 248 prototype files and 488 artifacts. Some text is explicitly historical; current-status summary must not repeat those values as current.
records.required_action: Reconcile the current status paragraph and clearly label all older snapshots as historical; preserve history.

records.topic: Historical 243 prototype-file count in research index/inventory note
records.finding: The 243-file count is a historical review-snapshot scope, not current count; B4 PR #127 updates the README caveat and inventory to 489 records.
records.required_action: After PR #127 disposition, reconcile B6 index/register with merged inventory; do not overwrite the historic review count.

records.topic: RT-17 diagnostic replay study
records.finding: PR #128 contains bounded diagnostic replay evidence but remains branch-only at this audit snapshot.
records.required_action: Do not add its claims to main-baseline graph until merged and re-audited.

records.topic: RT-26 budget reservation experiment
records.finding: PR #129 contains bounded hierarchical reservation experiment evidence, but it remains branch-only; it does not close all RT-26 dimensions.
records.required_action: Keep evidence pending; after merge, update RT-26 trace with exact scope and limits.

records.topic: RT-23 exact-tree recovery PR
records.finding: PR #126 was authored against an earlier base and its body says it depends on #125; #125 is now merged, but the PR is currently reported non-mergeable.
records.required_action: Rebase/reconcile PR #126 separately before treating its evidence as current main.

records.topic: B4 duplicate/supersession audit
records.finding: B4 audit PR is open and CI green, but its supersession edges and index/inventory changes are not merged into main.
records.required_action: After review/merge, promote only scoped relationships and refresh baseline inventory.

records.topic: B5 traceability graph audit
records.finding: B5 report PR is open and CI green, but not merged; B6 is independently based on main and treats B5 findings as pending-source audit inputs.
records.required_action: After review/merge, register B5 report and reconcile inventory/index without rewriting baseline facts.

records.topic: RT-04 Native Reproduction protocol top-level status
records.finding: The protocol's opening status says a workflow execution is still required, while its later section and the C audit record successful run #44774296240 with 10/10 commands passed. The opening status is stale, not a contradictory experiment result.
records.required_action: Update the top-level status to reflect the completed bounded reproduction; retain the run history, artifact retention limit, and exact source-identity caveats.
